item.title: DTCC completes first live tokenized stock and Treasury production trades with JPMorgan, BlackRock and Goldman Sachs.
U.S. Senate leadership says CLARITY Act will not pass before summer recess, delaying federal digital asset market structure law.
U.S. regulatory agencies miss July 18 GENIUS Act deadline for final stablecoin rules; $310 billion market faces uncertainty.
EU regulators move to ban 14 third-country crypto firms from serving EU clients under expanded MiCA enforcement.
BNY Mellon plans 24/7 blockchain settlement for U.S. Treasuries, targeting 2027 launch following stablecoin issuer test.
Full MiCA compliance costs expected to drive M&A consolidation in Europe, with banks seen as primary acquirers.
U.S. and U.K. regulators publish 10-point roadmap to coordinate rules for tokenized assets and cross-border stablecoins.
SEC plans to release Regulation Crypto proposal in July to exempt certain digital asset activities from securities law.
Revised CLARITY Act text bans U.S. president, lawmakers and judges from issuing or holding crypto tokens for compensation.
Stablecoin market reaches $310 billion on GENIUS Act first anniversary; Citi projects $4 trillion market by 2030.
Bitcoin and Ethereum cross-chain bridges lose $35 million in six simultaneous attacks within hours on July 23.
Tokenization is a strategic priority for 84% of financial institutions, according to a Broadridge survey.
Crypto projects lost $972 million to hacks in H1 2026 across record 207 incidents; North Korea linked to 76% of losses.
